title: Glowing laptop
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- laptop lid / screen -->
  <rect x='20' y='18' width='60' height='42' rx='4' fill='#5a6b8c'/>
  <rect x='24' y='22' width='52' height='34' rx='2' fill='#1b2436'/>
  <!-- glowing screen content -->
  <rect x='28' y='26' width='44' height='26' rx='2' fill='#3fd4ff'/>
  <rect x='31' y='29' width='30' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#d9f7ff'/>
  <rect x='31' y='35' width='38' height='2.5' rx='1.25' fill='#bff0ff'/>
  <rect x='31' y='41' width='24' height='2.5' rx='1.25' fill='#bff0ff'/>
  <rect x='31' y='47' width='34' height='2.5' rx='1.25' fill='#bff0ff'/>
  <!-- screen glow halo -->
  <rect x='24' y='22' width='52' height='34' rx='2' fill='none' stroke='#8fe7ff' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- base / keyboard -->
  <path d='M14 60 L86 60 L92 70 L8 70 Z' fill='#7c8db0'/>
  <path d='M14 60 L86 60 L87 63 L13 63 Z' fill='#9fb0d4'/>
